name: Lume - Your tech-savvy guide.
tagline: A voice-activated on-screen tutor that highlights exactly where seniors should click.

awards: Best Use of ElevenLabs by MLH

problem: Small tech tasks are hard for older adults and create dependence.
solution: A Chrome extension listens to questions, reads the screen with AI agents, and highlights the right buttons step by step while speaking instructions.
demo_moment: Team-described: ask how to join a Zoom call and watch the buttons light up.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Education + Entertainment Track” and “Best Use of ElevenLabs by MLH” among 195 submissions.
Framed as a grandchild who is always available.

lessons: A relationship metaphor (the helpful grandkid) sells an assistive tool.
